units.source_text: 我从没想过要为这位慈母设置盂兰盆会的祭坛。

en.t: I had never thought of setting up an Obon altar for this loving mother.

units.source_text: 我更没想过请女巫师降神，听母亲叙述那个世界的情形。

en.t: Still less had I thought of asking a female shaman to summon her spirit and listen as my mother described what things were like in that other world.

units.source_text: 我倒不如把杂木林中的一株小树当作母亲，同这株小树对话，这样可能会使我更满意呢。

en.t: I would probably have been more satisfied treating a small tree in the thicket as my mother and speaking with that little tree instead.
